description: Na₄W(NO)₂ is Aluminum carbonitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄O square pyramids, corners with four equivalent NaN₂O₂ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent WN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.43 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four N and one O atom to form distorted NaN₄O square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one WN₂O₂ tetrahedra, corners with five NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaN₄O square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent WN₂O₂ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.68 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.53 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four N and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.54 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.91 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form distorted NaN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaN₄O square pyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent WN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaN₄O square pyramid. Both Na-N bond lengths are 2.41 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond length. W is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form WN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaN₄O square pyramid, corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaN₄O square pyramids. Both W-N bond lengths are 1.85 Å. Both W-O bond lengths are 1.91 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to five Na and one W atom to form distorted NNa₅W octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NNa₅W octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃W tetrahedra, and edges with six NNa₅W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-38°. In the second N site, N is bonded to five Na and one W atom to form distorted NNa₅W octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NNa₅W octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃W tetrahedra, and edges with six NNa₅W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-38°. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form ONa₃W tetrahedra that share corners with four NNa₅W octahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃W tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-69°.
